care_unit_to_case_closure_days.description: (cases.TimeOfStay - cases.ICUOffset) / 86400 days; first intensive or intermediate care transfer to case closure, not ICU-only length of stay

death_during_case.description: Nullable death within the SICdb case interval, using recorded death offset and hospital disposition

death_time_during_case_hours.description: (cases.OffsetOfDeath - cases.ICUOffset) / 3600 hours when death is known within the case interval; unknown otherwise
